text:
The flops were formerly ecumulated with many
conferences altogether insignificant; the few now retain-
ed have in general either an agreeable flavour to re-
commend them, or are capable of answering some
ofeful purpose as medicine. Their common dole is
the bulk of a nutmey, or as much as can be taken up
at once or twice upon the point of a knife. There is
in general no great danger of exceeding in this parti-
cular.

parsed.faithful: The flops were formerly encumbered with many conferences altogether insignificant; the few now retained have in general either an agreeable flavour to recommend them, or are capable of answering some useful purpose as medicine. Their common dole is the bulk of a nutmeg, or as much as can be taken up at once or twice upon the point of a knife. There is in general no great danger of exceeding in this particular.
